roots.contract: Freeze objective, audience, hard constraints, plausible interpretations, target construct and claim scope; block goal substitution and unresolved decision-relevant ambiguity.
Separate artifact acceptance from search closure; require sufficient candidate diversity, anti-fixation search and novelty-safe escape before claiming no materially better candidate remains.

Bind every quality claim to exact artifact/system bytes, delivery environment, experienced realization and sufficient observation channels; block render, hidden-surface, multiscale and TOCTOU substitution failures.
Establish construct validity, criterion ontology, absolute professional floor, decision resolution and challenge validity; block rubric, scale, normalization and proxy gaming.

Qualify evaluators and references locally by criterion, artifact class, difficulty, state and relevant provenance; preserve disagreement and treat reference standards as fallible evidence rather than truth.
Admit typed evidence with provenance, grounding, independence/common-cause accounting, freshness and uncertainty semantics; forbid circular meta-evaluation and type laundering.

Separate quality prediction from causal explanation and edit prescription; require intervention fidelity, causal attribution, version/dose scope and post-edit regression checks before promoting reusable design rules.

Bind claims to the correct constituency, subgroup, evaluator assignment, presenter/operator, context and protocol; account for representation, invariance, social influence, strategic reporting and reactivity.
Bind quality to target horizons and deployment dynamics; account for drift, carryover, missing outcomes, rare failures, distribution tails, transport, performativity and path-dependent equilibria.

Freeze or robustify admissible analysis, aggregation, compensation, risk and normative policy; preserve Pareto/incomparability structure and model multiplicity rather than selecting convenient scalarizations after outcomes are known.

Protect development, selection and certification boundaries against adaptive optimization, leakage, acquired contamination, evaluation awareness, prompt/control-plane attacks, holdout reuse and evaluator-policy selection bias.

Require assumption-guarantee composition, same-subject root conjunction, abstraction soundness, independent defeater search, coverage accounting, proof-search honesty, meta-controller falsification and nonvacuity.

challenges.attack: Artifact satisfies an easier proxy while violating the user's actual objective.
Winner changes across plausible interpretations that were never resolved.
A material criterion or candidate is absent from the consideration set, changing the decision.
Evaluator is correct but search never generates a genuinely excellent candidate.
Candidates share one lineage/style and miss a distant superior design.
A superior unfamiliar design is rejected because reference-conforming familiarity is mistaken for quality.
Judge sees extracted text or lossy capture that collapses materially different audience experiences.
Judgment uses notes, metadata, off-canvas objects or other audience-irrelevant channels.
Every local element looks acceptable while sequence or whole-artifact quality fails.
The delivered artifact differs materially from the frozen artifact that was evaluated.
Artifact maximizes measured criteria while failing an omitted material quality dimension.
Audience succeeds on exposed or surface-matched tasks without deployment-relevant understanding.
Best available candidate is certified excellent despite remaining below the professional standard.
Splitting one value into many correlated criteria creates artificial decision weight.
Adding irrelevant alternatives or changing scale range reverses the winner.
Synthetic challenge is fresh but unrealistic, nondiagnostic or oracle-unsound and therefore gives false reassurance.
Candidate is penalized for disagreeing with a fallible or plural professional reference label.
Identical content receives different quality judgment because of source, brand or benchmark provenance.
Evaluator recognizes exposed benchmark/style anchors and appears competent without generalizing.
Judge has strong aggregate accuracy but fails near the actual finalist boundary.
Judge competence changes materially by style, domain, novelty or quality region.
Evaluator severity, discrimination or criterion interpretation changes during the session.
Many judges or observations share one causal source and are incorrectly counted as independent evidence.
Evaluator-of-evaluator chain terminates in mutual agreement rather than target grounding.
Weak evidence such as correlation or preference is promoted into causal, universal or factual certainty.
A confidence level, posterior probability, predictive risk and deployment risk are treated as interchangeable.
A derivation relies on an unstated premise or unsupported transport step.
A feature predicts quality but performing the corresponding edit degrades quality.
A winning edit changes several qualities but one component is falsely credited as causal.
Different implementations of the same named edit have materially different effects.
Individually positive edits interact or become harmful when sequenced.
Weak artifact appears strong because an exceptional presenter or operator rescues it.
A target stakeholder stratum is absent; weighting observed groups cannot recover it.
Groups use nominally identical scales or thresholds differently, invalidating pooled comparison.
Post-discussion consensus is treated as independent corroboration despite conformity or dominance.
Disconnected or selective judge-artifact assignment confounds quality with judge severity or expertise.
Stakeholder reports are strategically distorted because reports influence outcomes.
Preference query framing or deliberation changes the preference being measured enough to change the decision.
Evaluation itself changes attention or behavior, producing a winner that loses in ordinary deployment.
Exposure to an earlier candidate teaches content and artificially improves a later candidate's outcome.
Candidate wins immediately but loses on target-relevant delayed recall, decision quality or action.
Hard or harmed users disappear from outcome measurement, making observed quality look better.
Zero observed failures is interpreted as zero or acceptably tiny failure probability without sufficient structural/statistical support.
Strong mean quality hides catastrophic low-tail or critical-subgroup failures.
Challenge distribution lacks support for deployment contexts where the quality relation changes.
Deployed policy changes the observed population so its own prior judgment appears increasingly correct.
Same policy has multiple reachable equilibria and evaluation samples only the favorable basin.
A favorable defensible-looking analysis is selected after outcomes are observed while alternatives reverse the decision.
Large strength on one dimension offsets a veto-level weakness that the target does not permit trading off.
Large improvement over a weak baseline is relabeled as absolute excellence.
Multiple evidence-compatible quality models fit similarly but recommend different winners.
False-certification tolerance, loss function or decision threshold is changed after seeing results.
Candidate content changes evaluator instructions or tool behavior instead of merely supplying evidence.
Large adaptive search selects evaluator-specific false positives that fail fresh evidence.
Failed terminal evidence is repeatedly reused until candidates overfit it.
Information about the evaluation is acquired during the run and contaminates later behavior or evidence.
System or interactive artifact behaves differently because it detects evaluation conditions.
Agent alters scorer, files, monitoring or other evaluation machinery rather than honestly improving the deliverable.
Evaluator/router policy is itself selected on noisy calibration evidence and overfits the calibration set.
Different candidates satisfy different branches but no single exact artifact satisfies the conjunction.
Assurance claims support one another through an ungrounded dependency cycle.
A component contract omits downstream-relevant behavior and falsely preserves assurance under substitution.
Failure to find a proof is interpreted as false, impossible or safely irrelevant.
Controller prunes a branch as low-value although it contains a material blocker.
A materially distinct false-certification mechanism has no mapped root control or test.
System avoids false positives only by never certifying known-excellent artifacts.
Judge verdict shifts when told that a low score will trigger retraining, decommissioning or another consequential action.
Evaluator systematically favors or disfavors outputs from its own model family despite matched quality.
Calibration learned on one model or candidate class is reused across another and reverses the estimated comparison with high apparent confidence.
Evaluator preference is driven by stylistic presentation more strongly than the target content-quality construct.
